description:
Write, with each archive execution, a record holding that target's executions, so evidence is addressable by target without the event log.

## Background

`finalize_archive_execution` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/archive.rs`) merges its own writes with the issue and event actions into one delta, so one more write joins the same redo record. Executions are `domain::artifact_execution::ArchiveExecution` values, and the event `ArtifactArchiveExecuted` wraps one. Execute captures its base through `capture_archive_base` (`commands/validate.rs:343`). A new data-root directory must join `RepositoryLayout::tracker_written_paths` (`repository_state/path.rs:537-560`), whose test lists every tracker-written path (`gate_execution.rs:1122-1135`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each archive execution writes `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, holding the target and its ordered `ArchiveExecution` list (the captured prior list plus this execution), in the same redo record as its event. The key is `container/<issue-id>` or `document/<sha256 of the normalized path>`, built by one `VirtualPath` constructor; the record type derives `JsonSchema`; the directory is a tracker-written path; and execute's capture includes the target's record.
- [hard] REQ-02: Finalizer unit tests show the first execution creating the record and a re-execution appending to it.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Archive executions write a per-target evidence record
